YOUR EVERYDAY CHAT WORKSPACE

Less switching.
More conversation.

From a quick reply to a saved screenshot. The everyday things, together.

01 / TALK

A place for every conversation.

Keep channels and tells organized. Pin people you chat with often, follow unread counts, and see the fixed recipient before you send.

Fixed-target tellsUnread countsChat popouts
02 / FIND

Find what you said before.

Search history stored on your computer, organized by character. Bookmark useful messages and add a note for later.

Local historyKeyword searchFavorites & notes
03 / FRIENDS

Friends, a little closer.

Open a tell from the game-synced friend list and see available presence information. Enable online avatars if you like.

Synced friendsPresenceQuick conversations
04 / DETAILS

Look closer at links.

Open item and map cards beside your messages, with available details and equipment comparisons.

Item cardsMap locationsEnglish & Chinese
05 / A GLIMPSE

Bring the view back to your desktop.

Request a game screenshot, inspect the preview, then save or copy the image. A small look at what is happening on your game PC.

Requires the game/plugin to be running and screenshot access enabled.

START WITH YOUR DESKTOP

Three steps.
Then you’re in.

Install the matching plugin and client from this release.

  1. 01

    Install the plugin

    Add the custom repository in Dalamud, install XIVChatNext Server, log in to a character and enable your connection.

  2. 02

    Open the desktop app

    Extract the Windows ZIP and run XIVChat Desktop.exe. Choose language, connection and notification preferences.

  3. 03

    Connect and confirm

    Use the game PC’s address or a relay invitation. Compare fingerprints and confirm trust on both ends.

Your Dalamud plugin repository

Add this address in Dalamud settings → Experimental → Custom plugin repositories.

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AinaSnow/FFXIV-Dalamud-Plugins/main/pluginmaster.json

Make the client feel like yours.

Learn conversations, history, screenshots, popouts and the first connection.

CHOOSE YOUR CONNECTION

Nearby, or a little further away.

Choose the connection that fits where you are.

01 · DIRECT

Your game is within reach.

On the same computer or a reachable local network, connect straight to the game plugin.

Desktop client↔Game plugin
  • Same computer: 127.0.0.1
  • Default port: 14777, unless changed
  • Compare fingerprints and save device trust
02 · OPTIONAL RELAY

Meet at your own server.

If the game PC is not directly reachable, both ends can connect to a relay you host.

Client↔Your relay↔Plugin
  • English/Chinese web administration
  • Create devices, issue invitations and view sessions
  • Saved authorization survives normal restarts

Both modes need the game running, a logged-in character and the plugin. A relay does not replace game login.

Hosting your own relay? Read the advanced guide ↗

GOOD TO KNOW

Before your
first connection.

Can I chat with the game closed?

Live sending, friend updates and screenshots depend on the running game plugin. Locally saved history can still be read offline.

Do I need a new invitation after each restart?

No. Invitations establish initial pairing. Their expiry does not revoke already saved credentials. Re-pair after revoked/lost credentials, cleared configuration or an endpoint identity change.

Which languages are supported?

The website and application UI are available in English and Simplified Chinese. New plugin configurations default to English. The desktop package keeps English, Japanese, German, Chinese and French runtime resources.

Where is my history stored?

On the desktop computer, organized by character. Favorites and notes also stay local. The optional relay is not a cloud history service.

Is this an official FFXIV application?

No. XIVChat Next is an independent community project based on XIVChat and is not affiliated with Square Enix.
